info.title: OpenAsy Meet
info.description: Video meetings on LiveKit: meeting links, access tokens for the call, a lobby for guests, recordings by Egress where meet.yaml allows them, and the media server's health. Members (the user role) start, join and record their own meetings; viewers see every meeting and the server; editors' tokens let Calendar and Chat make meetings for someone; admins also stop recordings, delete any, and manage members and tokens.

recording.description: A recording runs now: people are told before they come in.

ticket.description: The guest's place in the lobby: send it in X-Lobby-Ticket. Shown once.

invited.description: Their email is on the invitation.

Stats.description: How a browser connects, every few seconds while in a call: shown on the Server page for 90 seconds and not kept.

sending.description: What it sends: camera:720p, screen:1080p, audio or none.

browser.description: Such as Firefox 132 or Safari on iPhone.
